verdict.rationale: mise has a dedicated continuous-integration doc with a GitHub Action (mise-action) wrapping install/tool setup, environment variable pinning recommendations, safe-mode env vars (MISE_SAFE=1) to prevent code execution in CI, and non-interactive exec/install commands (mise install, mise exec) suitable for headless automation; tasks can also be run non-interactively via `mise run`. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of CI reliability beyond one community note that mise's own workflows just use plain `run: mise` steps rather than a more polished action-based setup, and no evidence of other CI providers (GitLab, CircleCI) being explicitly documented.
